accounts.description: Manage email accounts, syncing and sign-in.
accounts.removeConfirmBody: Every message, thread and folder of this account is deleted from this device, together with its stored credentials. There is no undo, and a backup made earlier is the only way back.

credentialLock.unreadableDetail: Their stored sign-in was not written by Satchel and will not be used. Remove the account and add it again.

backup.databaseDescription: Creates a consistent copy of the database and master key in a folder. A restore is staged and applied on the next start.
backup.databaseDesktopOnly: Database backups are only available in the desktop app.
backup.missingMasterKeyWarning: Warning: no master key was found, so encrypted credentials in this backup cannot be read.

backup.keyPassphrasePlaceholder: Leave empty to export the key unprotected
backup.keyPassphraseHint: The backup folder carries the key to every stored password, OAuth token and private PGP or S/MIME key. With a passphrase the key is wrapped and the folder is useless without it.
backup.acknowledgeUnprotectedKeyHint: Treat this folder like a password file. Anyone who copies it can read every account credential without being asked for anything.
backup.restorePassphraseHint: This backup carries a wrapped master key.

inlineImages.title: Embedded images
inlineImages.description: Logos and graphics from signatures are normally stored locally. If they are missing, Satchel fetches them from the provider every time you open the message — that costs time and fails offline.
inlineImages.desktopOnly: Only available in the desktop app.
inlineImages.throttled: The provider is throttling — pausing for about {duration}
inlineImages.allPresent: All embedded images are stored locally.
inlineImages.note: Runs in the background at a throttled pace so the provider does not block us. Can be paused at any time — images already fetched are kept.
inlineImages.eta: about {duration} left — expected to finish around {time}
inlineImages.upfront: A full run takes at least about {duration} — finishing around {time} at the earliest.
inlineImages.stalled: Stopped — too many errors in a row. {count} images fetched{tail}.
inlineImages.startFailed: The backfill could not be started.

accounts.removeRequiresApp: Konten löschen ist nur in der Desktop-App möglich.

backup.missingMasterKeyWarning: Achtung: Kein Master-Key gefunden, verschlüsselte Zugangsdaten sind in dieser Sicherung nicht lesbar.

inlineImages.description: Logos und Grafiken aus Signaturen liegen normalerweise lokal vor. Fehlen sie, holt Satchel sie bei jedem Öffnen erneut beim Anbieter — das kostet Zeit und läuft offline ins Leere.
